confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Nominal ARS levels for July 2026 are the weakest part because of Argentina's high and volatile inflation and exchange rate, so absolute amounts may be well off even if the relative structure holds. Lodging anchors are especially uncertain because many listings are priced in USD or change often. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general Latin American capital-city price tiers, adjusted to Buenos Aires' own relationships between cafes, restaurants and lodging. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the draft beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
